website.error: no public drug pipeline page (Philips is a medical-device / health-technology company, not a drug developer)

ctgov.note: Trials listed are predominantly investigator-initiated studies in which Philips imaging/monitoring devices are used as tools, plus a small number of Philips-subsidiary-sponsored device studies (Philips Electronics Nederland BV, Philips Portuguesa S.A.). No proprietary drug candidates.

commercial_product.note: Philips is a global health-technology company. Marketed product portfolio includes Diagnostic Imaging (CT, MRI, ultrasound, IGT), Patient Monitoring, Image-Guided Therapy, Sleep & Respiratory Care, and Personal Health. These are commercialized medical devices, not drugs.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Philips appears in many ClinicalTrials.gov entries as a device provider in investigator-initiated or third-party-sponsored studies (e.g. NIH/NHLBI, NYU Langone, Guy's and St Thomas', Region Skane, Imunon, Complexa). These are not Philips proprietary clinical programs and are excluded.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Philips is a medical-device / health-technology company (foreign private issuer; files 20-F rather than 10-K). It does not develop proprietary drug candidates. ClinicalTrials.gov entries naming Philips/Philips subsidiaries are overwhelmingly investigator-initiated trials using Philips imaging or monitoring equipment as a tool, not company-sponsored pivotal device IDE studies of new investigational devices. No active proprietary P1/P2/P3 drug or pivotal IDE pipeline reportable under this scope.
